integrity: The general formulas are proved analytically. Exact finite checks are supplementary, and bibliographic novelty remains qualified by possible equivalent arithmetic or Fourier formulations.
scientific_limitations: Integer expanding circle maps with uniform initial condition and standard equal-width aligned partitions only; addresses pairwise information and the finite bin transition spectrum, not higher-order independence or other partitions.
title: Arithmetic spectral cycles and information loss for equal-bin expanding maps
